hypothesis: Fallback-only omission of historical reasoning prevents rare 8K archive admission failures while preserving the identifier-aware arm's accuracy, token, and time advantages against native convergence.
selection_rule: Project only the eight source-only parquet columns; exclude all prior G01 task IDs; select four remaining code-token-bearing titles from the hash-ordered eligible list, one per pinned repository; verify each base commit in its pinned cache. No gold_context, patch, or test_patch inspection before the freeze.
decision_rule: Run and report all four matched pairs. Seal every final prediction or exact completed no-final-context result before pinned native scoring. Assign zero Span/File-F1 only to exact completed instrument.no-final-context attempts with known model-token receipts; provider and infrastructure errors invalidate a pair. Aggregate pass requires all four pairs valid, candidate macro Span-F1 and File-F1 strictly above control, total known model tokens and duration strictly below control, and at most one Span-F1 regression. Report fallback activation count and all task-level outcomes.
claim_ceiling: Four-task prospective G01 test of fallback-only reasoning omission; not a repair of earlier campaigns, full ContextBench, or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
